plan: With a private value of $29, I want to maximize my potential profit. In a sealed bid ascending auction, my optimal strategy is to bid strategically close to, but below my true value. Since there are two other bidders and values are randomly drawn, I'll bid just low enough to have a good chance of winning while preserving potential profit margin. A bid around $25 seems optimal - high enough to likely win, but leaving room for profit if I win at a lower price.
